encyclopedia.untildawn.unknown: You know nothing of this mob yet. Survive the night it first appears on to learn about it.
encyclopedia.untildawn.miner: A zombie with a wooden pickaxe. It digs straight through blocks when that is quicker than walking around, tunnels for squadmates who ask, and calls on Builders for bridges and stairs where it can't go on. Hard walls take it a long time.
encyclopedia.untildawn.builder: A zombie with a wooden shovel that makes a way the whole squad can follow: bridges, straight stairs, and ladders up walls or down drops. It builds with Unstable Planks and Ladders, which it can break itself and which crumble away when the night ends. Without it, a squad is stuck at the first cliff.
encyclopedia.untildawn.bomber: A creeper that backs up its squad. It warns squadmates, walks up to a wall and lights its fuse, and they rush through the breach. Its blast wears down every block near it: weak walls fall, strong ones are only cracked. Reaching the Core, it detonates for heavy damage.
encyclopedia.untildawn.archer: A skeleton that shoots straight at anything it can see. Its arrows chip at the blocks they hit, so walls and barricades wear down under sustained fire.
encyclopedia.untildawn.longbowman: A skeleton in leather armour with a Punch bow. It starts shooting from much further away, and arcs its arrows high over cover onto targets it can't see. Its arrows leave a white trail.
encyclopedia.untildawn.sprinter: A fast, empty-handed zombie that sprint-jumps across gaps the others must bridge or walk around. It can't dig or build, so a solid wall stops it.
encyclopedia.untildawn.swarmer: A plain melee zombie in scraps of leather with a simple sword. It can't dig or build; it walks for the Core and fights whatever is in its way. Dangerous only in numbers.
encyclopedia.untildawn.warrior: An armoured husk with a shield. When hurt it raises the shield for a while and keeps advancing behind it, slowly, unable to attack. A hit with an axe disables the shield.
encyclopedia.untildawn.assassin: Hunts alone, never in a squad. It fires a crossbow bolt that slows you from six blocks away, closes in with an Iron Dagger while you are slowed, then sprints back out to reload once the slowness wears off.
encyclopedia.untildawn.webber: A spider that bites like any other. Every 10 seconds it spits a web at its target, leaving cobwebs that hold you in place for a few seconds before they vanish. Spiders pass through them freely.
encyclopedia.untildawn.sneaking_spider: A cave spider that creeps up invisible and silent. Within 5 blocks it shows itself with a gust of cloud and lunges, then fights like any cave spider.
